gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints three fund columns (Water Fund, Sewer Fund, Trash Fund) with no schedule lines in detail[]. JSON statement receipts = Sales + Other revenue + nonoperating Interest income, Grant revenue, County support - recycling. Water Fund: Sales 179,890 + Other revenue 790 + Interest income 306 + Grant revenue 64,601 = 245,587; Sewer Fund: Sales 96,058 + Interest income 23 = 96,081; Trash Fund: Sales 63,479 + County support - recycling 3,000 = 66,479. 245,587 + 96,081 + 66,479 = 408,147 = statement total = gap. Check: 0 + 408,147 = 408,147. No transfers printed.
